title: The "Payment" HTTP Authentication Scheme (draft-httpauth-payment-01, repository source)
publisher: Tempo Labs and Stripe (B. Ryan, J. Moxey, T. Meagher, J. Weinstein, S. Kaliski)
notes: Challenge parameters, credential, Payment-Receipt, Accept-Payment, Payment-Authorization, problem types, HMAC binding, IANA registrations. Repository file last changed 2026-09-21 (PR #362, HMAC header slot vectors), after the -01 datatracker upload.

title: Charge Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-payment-intent-charge-00)
notes: Shared request fields amount, currency, recipient, description, externalId, methodDetails; atomicity rules.

title: Subscription Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-payment-intent-subscription-00)
notes: Fields amount, currency, periodUnit, periodCount, subscriptionExpires; lifecycle; subscriptionId in receipt. First merged 2026-07-29 (PR #230).

title: Tempo Session Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-tempo-session-00)
notes: Actions open, topUp, voucher, close; EIP-712 vouchers; 15-minute forced close grace period; sessionProtocol v1 and v2; session problem types.

title: Stripe Charge Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-stripe-charge-00)
notes: SPT payload field spt; methodDetails.networkId and paymentMethodTypes; PaymentIntent settlement; Stripe Connect parameters.

title: Card Network Charge Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-card-charge-00)
notes: Method card; encrypted network token in JWE; Client Enabler and Server Enabler; client may include TAP signature headers. File present since the repository's first commit (authored 2026-01-05, public 2026-03-18); last changed 2026-04-16.

title: Tempo Charge Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-tempo-charge-00)
notes: Method id tempo; methodDetails chainId (default 42431), feePayer, memo, splits, supportedModes; payload types transaction, hash, proof; proof domain versions 1 to 3.

title: Tempo Subscription Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-tempo-subscription-00)
notes: periodUnit day or week only; subscriptionExpires REQUIRED; methodDetails.accessKey with keyType p256, secp256k1 or webAuthn; payload type keyAuthorization; chainId default text says 42431 (Tempo mainnet), which contradicts other specs.

title: Stripe Subscription Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-stripe-subscription-00)
notes: Payload paymentMethod and customer; receipt reference is a Stripe invoice ID plus stripeSubscription.

title: Lightning Network Charge and Session Intents (draft-lightning-charge-00, draft-lightning-session-00)
notes: Method id lightning (BOLT11 invoice); session intent is a prepaid session with per-unit billing and refund on close. Session spec at https://github.com/tempoxyz/mpp-specs/blob/50309c8e67e6d64b5547f1cc354fb327bda1301e/specs/methods/lightning/draft-lightning-session-00.md.

publisher: Coinbase, MegaETH Labs, Monad Foundation (charge); OKG (session)
notes: Method id evm (ERC-20 transfer on any EVM chain). Charge merged 2026-04-17 (PR #213); session merged 2026-07-03 (PR #225).

title: Solana Charge and Session Intents (draft-solana-charge-00, draft-solana-session-00)
notes: Method id solana (SOL and SPL tokens). Charge merged 2026-03-24 (PR #188); session merged 2026-06-30 (PR #201).

title: Stellar Charge Intent (draft-stellar-charge-00)
notes: Method id stellar (SEP-41 token transfer). Merged 2026-03-29 (PR #199).

title: Hedera Charge and Session Intents (draft-hedera-charge-00, draft-hedera-session-00)

title: "usdc" Payment Method for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-usdc-charge-00)
notes: Method id usdc. Merged 2026-06-16 (PR #272).

title: NEAR Intents Charge Intent (draft-nearintents-charge-01)
notes: Method id nearintents (cross-chain via NEAR Intents 1Click Swap API). First merged 2026-06-21 (PR #284).

title: XRP Ledger Charge and Session Intents (draft-xrpl-charge-00, draft-xrpl-session-00)
notes: Method id xrpl (XRP, issued currencies, MPTs; off-ledger payment channel vouchers for session). Merged 2026-09-08 (PR #346).

title: Service Discovery for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-payment-discovery-01)
notes: GET /openapi.json; x-service-info and x-payment-info extensions; registry guidance; comparisons with A2A, MCP Registry, x402, x402scan, ERC-8004. -01 adds output schemas (PR #326, 2026-08-24).

title: Payment Authentication Scheme: JSON-RPC and MCP Transport (draft-payment-transport-mcp-00)
notes: Error -32042 Payment Required, -32043 verification failed; _meta keys org.paymentauth/credential and org.paymentauth/receipt; experimental.payment capability.
